Placeholder: a squad engages a spotted enemy on its own within this share of its best weapon's max range.
Placeholder: terrain whose cover ratio (terrain.json) is at least this counts as cover for the AI.

Placeholder:  the soonest another man joins the fire.

Placeholder:  chance a man does not fire at all through a fire task.

Placeholder:  a squad on Defend or Ambush holds its fire until an enemy is this close, unless it is fired on.

Placeholder:  a man at suppression 100 takes this much longer to get up (linear in his level).
